gates.name: visual_baseline
gates.pass: Reference screenshots exist and new app meets/exceeds them for composition, living depth, buttons, boards, typography and icon quality.

gates.name: welcome_identity_hub_journey
gates.pass: Welcome → Identity → Intelligent Hub succeeds without routing to Academy/Powercast.

gates.name: identity_governance
gates.pass: Identity/session is established through the governed identity seam; local presentation cache is not treated as authority.

gates.name: canonical_navigation
gates.pass: One room registry drives rail/routes/themes; Smart Connect replaces historical Smart Share.

gates.name: button_causality
gates.pass: Every visible interactive control has a real causal path or explicit unavailable/blocked state.

gates.name: smart_connect_doors
gates.pass: Smart Connect reads the canonical Smart Door model; connection/capability never mints authority.

gates.name: truth_states
gates.pass: Loading, empty, blocked, unauthorized, unknown, error and success states are designed and honest.

gates.name: canonical_data
gates.pass: Hub consumes governed runtime/canonical intelligence and creates no second front-end brain/store.

gates.name: responsive_quality
gates.pass: Desktop/tablet/mobile preserve hierarchy, depth, semantic spectrum, tactile controls and readable intelligence.

gates.name: accessibility
gates.pass: Keyboard, visible focus, semantic labels, contrast, touch targets and reduced-motion behavior pass.

gates.name: performance
gates.pass: Realistic feed volume remains responsive without uncontrolled observers/polling/layout-thrashing animation.

gates.name: browser_app_behavior
gates.pass: Deep links, back/forward, refresh recovery and route guards behave coherently.

gates.name: runtime_proof
gates.pass: At least one real room completes identity → retrieval → action/refusal → observation → persisted/verified result through production-equivalent runtime.

gates.name: human_director_visual_review
gates.pass: Human Director confirms the result did not regress from the approved living-depth design floor.

next_action: Use these gates as the acceptance contract for Issue #1270; close the first failing gate without weakening any prior gate.
